**1. Signature with the reference suite — concluded, without interface.** The twenty-second round's method gave zero signatures because it opened
the document as `PackageFormat` (or `OFOPXMLFormat`), which hides the signature streams. The reference suite signs and verifies
on a **`ZipFormat`** storage, for ODF and OOXML: with that, `DocumentDigitalSignatures.verifyDocumentContentSignatures`
(macro module in a throwaway profile, reference suite headless) gives the expected results on the calibration files of
the external test corpus (`good.odt` valid, `bad.odt` invalid, `multi.docx` two valid signatures, `bad.docx` invalid) and on
ours: ODT, ODS, ODP, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX signed by `DocumentSignatureService` **valid**, untrusted certificate
(self-signed, `CertificateStatus` 1), OOXML "partial" as always; the six copies with one byte changed **invalid**.
The tool is now `tools/verify-signatures`. No interface opened, no clicks.
- **Medium, fixed** — signing an ODT with Basic macros written by the reference suite failed with `XmlException`: the
  `Basic/*.xml` modules have a `<!DOCTYPE … "module.dtd">` declaration and canonicalization prohibited it; the same
  happened when verifying such a document signed by others. Now the declaration is ignored (no DTD loaded, no
  entity expanded, as C14N does, which does not carry it over). Test `UnDocumentoConMacroBasicSiFirmaNonostanteLaDichiarazioneDelTipo`;
  also verified by the reference suite (our `firma.odt` with macros and dialogs is valid).

**2. HTML pasted from other apps.** Typical fragments written to the clipboard with `osascript` (web page as Chrome
copies it, with computed styles; Google Docs; Word with `<style>` and `mso-`; Excel; the reference suite's word processor and spreadsheet) read by
`HtmlDocumentReader` (Folio, and Deck through the same reader) and by `HtmlTableReader` (Ledger):
- **Medium, fixed** — `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` (the "transparent" background browsers write all the time) became opaque
  black: black highlighting and paragraph background, unreadable text. `CssDeclarations.Color` now reads the alpha (also
  `rgb(0 0 0 / 0%)`) and a transparent colour is absent.
- **Minor, fixed** — site backgrounds: white or near-white (every channel ≥ F5) `background-color` on text,
  paragraphs and cells is the paper colour and does not become highlighting, background or fill (`ICssDeclarations.Background`).
- **Minor, fixed** — fonts: `-apple-system`, `BlinkMacSystemFont`, `system-ui`, the generic families, `inherit`
  and `var(--…)` ended up as the font name; now the first concrete family in the list is taken ("Segoe UI") or
  none (`ICssDeclarations.FontFamily`).
- **Minor, fixed** — absurd measures: sizes outside 1–400 pt (900px, 0.1px) are ignored; negative margins and paddings
  of a web page do not become negative indents.
- **Minor, fixed** — Ledger had its own colour reader (`Hex`) that did not know CSS names (Excel's `background:yellow`)
  and treated the site's white as a fill: it now uses the same `ICssDeclarations`.
- Google Docs (Arial, bold via `font-weight:700`, `background-color:transparent`), Word (Times New Roman 14 red,
  list indents), the reference suite (Liberation Serif, intended yellow cell background) stay as in the original, as
  Word and the reference suite do with "keep source formatting". "Text only" exists in all three modules with
  ⌥⇧⌘V (Folio and Deck "paste unformatted text", Ledger "paste values only") and in Paste special.
  Test `HtmlFromOtherAppsTests` (three cases). **Seen on screen**: the web page and Google Docs pasted into Folio without
  black bands or backgrounds, the heading at 36 pt, the transparent text readable, Google's table with borders
  (`incolla-web.png`); then ⌥⇧⌘V pastes only "plain text".

**3. Folio and Deck driven only by the agent** (`tools/mcp-client`, "edit" and "files" levels). Folio: 126 paragraphs
with a title, 30 chapters in Heading 1, italics, five filled tables, bookmark, date field, replacement of 90
occurrences, revisions; Deck: 12–30 slides with titles, bodies, notes, one hidden, one deleted. What the agent
reads matches the screen and `render_page` (`folio-lungo.png`, `folio-p1-agente.png`, `deck-agente.png`); ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z
from the keyboard undo and redo the agent's steps one by one (`folio-annullato.png`, `deck-annullato.png`); at
the "edit" level file commands are refused ("needs the 'files' permission"); at the "files" level save as
over an existing file opens the modal with backdrop, "Rifiuta" (Deny) leaves the file as it was and tells the agent, "Consenti" (Allow)
overwrites it (`conferma.png`).
- **Medium, fixed** — in Ledger an invalid reference (`Read("pippo")`, `Write("pippo", 1)`) did nothing and
  the agent received "Done." (even from a read): now `IScriptReferences` gives an error ("'pippo' is not a cell
  reference.") throughout `SheetFacade`, and the two `Scope` copies in Validation and FormatRule are the same service. Test
  `UnRiferimentoNonValidoDaErroreInveceDiNonFareNulla`.
- **Medium, fixed** — Deck's `render_page` numbered the printed pages, which skip hidden slides: after a
  hidden one the drawn "slide 7" was the eighth. Now the agent sees every slide (`IDocumentOperations.BuildPages`,
  `IDeckPublisher.BuildEverySlide`).
- **Minor, fixed** — in the same code the Deck PDF titles (bookmarks) came from all slides and the
  pages only from the visible ones: after a hidden slide every bookmark had the wrong title. Test
  `Una_diapositiva_nascosta_non_sposta_i_titoli_del_pdf_e_l_agente_le_vede_tutte`.
- **Minor, fixed** — Folio's `Paragraph`, `Style`, `Cell` and Deck's `Title`, `Body`, `Notes` on a number that does not
  exist gave empty text, indistinguishable from an empty paragraph: now an error with the real size. A read without a
  value returns `null`, "Done." only from `void` methods. Tests `Leggere_un_paragrafo_o_una_cella_che_non_esistono…`,
  `Una_lettura_senza_valore_torna_null_e_non_Done`.
- **Minor, fixed** — `SetBody` on a title slide said true and wrote nothing (there is no body): now the
  body of a title slide is the subtitle (seen on screen: "Consiglio di amministrazione"), and without a placeholder
  `SetTitle`/`SetBody` say false; descriptions updated in the five languages.
- **Minor, fixed** — every agent step was supposed to be "Agente: …" (Agent: …) in the history, but a transaction with a single
  operation pushed it as it was: the label was lost ("Annullato: Modifica il testo" (Undone: Edit text)) and the step could merge
  with its neighbours. `UndoStack.BeginLabelledStep` keeps the label and does not merge. Test
  `UnPassoEtichettatoTieneLEtichettaAncheConUnaSolaOperazione`.
- **Minor, fixed** — `save_document_as` to `agente.xyz` wrote an ODT with that extension: the save
  service fell back to the native format for every unknown extension. Now it refuses (`status.save.unknownFormat`
  in the five languages, the agent says which extensions to use); only a name without extension takes the native one.
- **Minor, fixed** — `render_page` with page 0 drew the first instead of giving an error.
- **Minor, fixed** — an argument type error was Jint's message ("No public methods…"): now it carries the
  expected signature and the meaning of each argument.
- **Minor, fixed** — the access code file was created only at the first authenticated request, and the
  `pulse-mcp` bridge crashed with an exception trace if it was missing: now the server creates it when it starts listening and the
  bridge says in one line that it is missing.
- **Observed, not a defect**: with tracked changes active `Paragraph` returns the text as it will be when accepted (the screen
  also shows the strikethrough); `InsertTable` with a selection replaces it, like every insertion; `Name` in Folio and Deck is
  the file name, empty if unsaved (documented), Ledger's is the title.

**4. Corpus**: full run repeated with this round's code: 9948 copies, 28 READFAIL and 14 non-ZIP (those of the
corpus), **LOSS 0, DECL 478**; `results.tsv` and `summary.md` regenerated and identical to the previous ones.

**Status: the twenty-third round did NOT find only minors**: four mediums (signing an ODT with Basic macros,
black transparent background from HTML, silent invalid references for the agent, wrong slide in `render_page` after
a hidden one), all fixed, plus twelve minors fixed.

**Left for the twenty-fourth**: open live in PulseOffice an ODT with macros signed by the reference suite (verification of
others' signatures with `DOCTYPE` parts); paste live into Ledger tables from web pages with computed styles; a long agent
round on Ledger (validations, filters, pivot) to look for other silent "does nothing" outside
`SheetFacade`.

## Audit, twenty-fourth round (2026-10-25)

Goal "minor defects only". `--no-incremental` build without warnings, full suite green in one pass (39 projects,
7505 tests), corpus rerun **LOSS 0, DECL 529** (478 + 51 Basic macros now counted and declared). Live trials with a
throwaway data folder (`live24`), window captured with `windowshot --pid`. **The app never managed to come to the
foreground** (the Claude app always stayed in front, and the foreground request via System Events was
ignored): by rule no click or key was sent; everything "live" went through the MCP agent
(`run_command`, content tools) with window captures. The Folio and Deck parts of item 2 were done by a
support agent in a worktree, merged into main (subsection below).

### 1. ODT with macros signed by the reference suite, live
`valid_ooo3_2_doc_macro.odt` from the external test corpus (document signature and macro signature of OOo 3.2) opened
from the command line: it opens, the status bar shows the signature, the bell reports a declared loss
(a screenshot). The reference suite headless (`tools/verify-signatures`) reports it valid with an untrusted certificate, as
we do (`UntrustedCertificate`); `invalid_ooo2_x_macro1.odt` invalid for both.
- **Serious, fixed** — the Basic macros of an **ODT or ODP** were lost on save **silently**: only the ODS
  reader declared `ODF041`. Now `OdfMacroMapper.BasicLoss` gives `ODF041` (Basic macros and their signature discarded) for ODS, ODT
  and ODP. The corpus run did not see it because it did not count macros: now it counts the `library:element` of Basic libraries and
  the modules of `Scripts/pulseoffice` ("macros" function, module DTD ignored with no resolver), and the full run finds
  51 copies with dropped macros, all declared (35 ODS, 16 ODT, previously silent).
- **Minor, fixed** — the status bar said "Firmato" (Signed) even with a certificate that cannot be verified (self-signed,
  expired, unknown authority): now "Firmato, certificato non verificato" (Signed, certificate not verified) (five languages, `signature.indicatorUnverified`),
  "Firma non valida" (Invalid signature) remains for broken signatures, like the icon with the warning in the reference suite.
- **Minor, fixed** — the document's embedded formula (`<?> cdot <?> times <?> times <?>`) showed StarMath
  placeholders as `< ? >`: now they are small squares as in the reference suite (`FormulaParser`, test
  `IlSegnapostoDiStarMathEUnQuadrato`). The formula was also drawn at half the height of the frame:
  the two duplicated painters (`FormulaContentPainter` of Folio and Deck, `FormulaPicturePainter` for the PNG) now use the
  same `IFormulaObjectRenderer`, which fills the frame like the reference suite (compared with the PNG from the reference suite
  headless, `lo-formula.png`).
- **Observed, not a defect**: Basic macros are not executed (project choice), so in PulseOffice they are not
  "present" (`MacroCount` 0) and the declared loss says so; OOo 2.x signatures that do not cover `Basic/` remain
  "invalid" for us (the reference suite calls them partial and cannot even open their `ZipFormat` storage).

### 2. Web tables pasted into Ledger, live
Wikipedia-style table (Chrome computed styles, caption, `rowspan`, `colspan`, numbers with spaces, reference
`[1]`, typographic minus) put on the clipboard with `osascript` and pasted with `run_command ledger.clipboard.paste`;
compared with the reference suite headless (`calc_HTML_WebQuery` → ODS).
- **Medium, fixed** — `rowspan`/`colspan` did not become merged cells (the reference suite merges them) and, more generally, **merged
  cells were lost when copying and pasting within Ledger**: `ClipboardSnapshot.Merges` carries the merges contained
  in the copied range and paste recreates them (with "formats"), undoable (test
  `CopiareEIncollareCelleUniteTieneLUnioneEDLaToglieAnnullando`).
- **Minor, fixed** — the caption (`<caption>`) was lost: now it is the first row, as in the reference suite.
- **Minor, fixed** — cell `text-align`/`align` and `vertical-align`/`valign` were ignored (numbers right-aligned,
  headers centred, "Isole" in the centre of the merge); `start`/`end` stay "general". Test
  `DidascaliaUnioniEAllineamentoDiUnaTabellaDelWebArrivanoAlFoglio`. Seen on screen (`ledger-web.png`).
- As in the reference suite, "10 020 528" and "−12,5%" stay text; HTML from Excel and from the reference suite pasted as in the previous
  round (`ledger-excel-lo.png`).

### 3. Agent round on Ledger
Sales table, formulas, names, validations, conditional formatting, filter, pivot, chart, protection, all from
`pulse-mcp` (`ledger-agente.png`, `protetto.png`, `protetto-bold.png`): what the agent reads matches the screen (the
rows hidden by the filter also hide the part of the pivot falling on them, as in the reference suite).
- **Serious, fixed** — macros and agent **ignored the protection** of sheet and structure: they wrote into locked
  cells, formatted, inserted rows, sorted, filtered, added validations and pivots on a protected sheet,
  while the interface refuses. `IScriptProtection` (with `ISheetEditGuard`, the same as the interface) in all
  Ledger facades: locked cells, formats, permissions for rows/columns/sort/filter, structure; `Replace` skips
  locked cells. Seen live on `sheet-protection.ods`: "The cell B2 is protected: unprotect the sheet first."
  Test `Le_macro_e_l_agente_rispettano_la_protezione_del_foglio_e_della_struttura`.
- **Medium, fixed** — `run_command` answered "Ran ledger.format.bold." even when the app refused the command (protected
  sheet, with the red warning on screen): `ShellAgentCommands` collects the error notices published during the
  command and the agent receives "did not run: <reason>" (`AgentCommandRun`, test `Un_comando_che_l_app_rifiuta_non_si_dice_eseguito`).
- **Medium, fixed** — a syntactically wrong formula from `Write`, `SetFormula`, `SetFormulaLocal`, `WriteRange`
  silently became a `#NAME?` cell: now an error with the position ("Expected an expression, found ''"), and
  `WriteRange` checks everything before writing (no half-done writes). The parser message was in Italian.
- **Observed, not a defect**: as in the reference suite, a macro's `Write` does not go through validation and a string
  "2026-01-05" stays text (`SetFormulaLocal` interprets it as typing does); "Proteggi foglio" (Protect sheet) requested by the agent opens
  the modal with backdrop and waits for the user (documented), so live protection was tried on a file
  from the reference suite that was already protected.

### 4. Silent "does nothing" in Ledger macros
Test `LedgerFacadeContractTests`: one case for **every** member of `SheetScriptApi` (121, eight roots), which fails if a
new member has no case; for each, wrong arguments → clear error, read-only → refusal, correct
arguments → observable effect on the model. Found and fixed (all **medium** except where stated):
- invalid references giving `false` or 0 instead of an error in filter, validations, conditional formatting,
  scenarios, merges, pivot;
- filter: `ByValues`/`ByCondition`/`ClearColumn`/`Values` without an active filter gave 0 (indistinguishable from "no rows
  hidden"), column outside the range not checked in `Values`;
- pivot: non-existent fields, no value field, duplicate name, occupied destination gave an empty id without a reason;
- print: unknown paper ignored, unknown orientation became portrait, negative `RepeatRows` clamped to 0,
  `ExportPdf` to an empty path, without `.pdf` or existing gave just false;
- sheet: unknown alignment became "general", unknown chart or shape type became columns or
  rectangle, unknown cell style did nothing, non-`#RRGGBB` colours accepted and written to the file, invalid size and
  font, non-existent number format, `InsertRows(1, 0)` inserted a row, negative `Freeze` clamped to 0,
  empty `WriteRange` did nothing, `DistinctValues` with a column outside the range;
- validations: minimum greater than maximum, unknown alert became "Stop", `Message` on a range without validation, and
  a failed construction **first removed** the existing validation; empty formula;
- names: invalid name ("A1", with spaces) or invalid expression accepted;
- colour scale with a single colour silently became the default one;
- **minor**: `Describe` of list validations did not show the values.
Colours go through `IScriptColors`, references through `IScriptReferences`, protection through `IScriptProtection`.

### 5. Suite and tests
- **Minor, fixed (test)** — `Trascinare_un_file_sulla_finestra_lo_apre` hung when run alone or in certain
  orders (also on the twenty-third round: tried in a clean worktree): the wait with `await Task.Delay` inside the headless
  session did not resume; now it waits with `Thread.Sleep` + `RunJobs` like the other tests.
- **Minor, fixed (test)** — `F6_porta_alla_ribbon…` always failed: since the nineteenth round F6 cycles through the areas
  (ribbon, document, pane, status bar) and from the document goes to the status bar, like Word; the test now uses
  Shift+F6 (`Maiusc_F6_dal_documento_porta_alla_ribbon…`).

### Folio and Deck macros: no more silent "does nothing"

Policy, the same as Ledger's: an invalid argument (paragraph, slide, table, row, column that do not
exist, NaN, unknown style, field or bookmark, empty name, table sizes outside 1–1000 × 1–64, positions
outside the paragraph) is `ArgumentException`/`ArgumentOutOfRangeException` with the real size or the allowed values; a
read-only document, protected or generated text, password-protected revisions, the only slide to
delete are `InvalidOperationException`. `false`/0 remains only for a legitimate outcome: `AddBookmark` with a name that
already exists (false, nothing added), `SetTitle`/`SetBody` on a slide without that placeholder, `Find`/`Replace`/
`AcceptAll`/`RejectAll` with no occurrences, `app.Run` of a command that does not apply right now. `app.Run` of a command that
does not exist is `ArgumentException`, of one forbidden to macros `InvalidOperationException` (`ScriptCommands`).
- **Serious, fixed** — `Bold`, `Italic`, `SetStyle` on a paragraph checked the protection of the paragraph **at the
  caret**, not of the one given: a paragraph in a protected section got formatted if the caret was elsewhere, and a
  free one was refused (false) if the caret was in an index. Now the target paragraph is checked.
- **Serious, fixed** — Folio's `Replace` also wrote inside protected sections and generated indexes; now it skips the
  protected occurrences and returns how many it replaced.
- **Medium, fixed** — Folio writes (`SetParagraph`, `SetStyle`, `Bold`, `Italic`, `SetCell`, `InsertTable`,
  `InsertField`, `AddBookmark`, `SetTrackChanges`, `UpdateFields`, `AppendParagraph`, `InsertText`) and Deck writes (`GoTo`,
  `DeleteSlide`, `SetNotes`, `Hide`, `SetTitle`, `SetBody`) silently gave false or 0 on wrong arguments or a
  read-only document, while the reads threw.
- **Medium, fixed** — `app.Run` with a non-existent or misspelled command only said false, like a command not
  applicable right now: a recorded macro with a renamed command did not report it.
- **Minor, fixed** — Deck's `AddSlide` did not check read-only (the dispatcher guard covered it only
  in the app) and returned the number of slides instead of the position of the new one.
- **Minor, fixed** — Folio's `Select` silently clamped positions outside the paragraph; `Find`/`Replace` with
  empty text gave 0; a cell covered by a merge was "non-existent" without saying so.
Catalogue descriptions changed in the five languages: `api.app.Run`, `api.presentation` (summary, `GoTo`,
`DeleteSlide`), `api.textdocument` (summary, `SetStyle`, `Replace`, `GoToBookmark`, `SetTrackChanges`).
Tests `FolioFacadeContractTests` and `DeckFacadeContractTests`: one case for **every** catalogue member (the test fails
if a member has no case), with wrong arguments, read-only and observable effect on the document.

### Status of the twenty-fourth round
**The twenty-fourth round did NOT find only minors**: five serious (protection ignored by macros and agent in Ledger;
wrong paragraph protection and `Replace` in protected sections in Folio; Basic macros of ODT and ODP lost
silently), some fifteen mediums (mostly silent "does nothing" in macros in the three modules, merges lost
on paste, `run_command` claiming to have run) and the listed minors: **all fixed**. Corpus **LOSS 0, DECL 529**.

**Left for the twenty-fifth**: the trials with clicks and keys that could not be done here because the app did not come to the
foreground — the signatures window on the reference suite's file, "Proteggi foglio" from the interface and then the agent on the
same sheet, Paste special of HTML; the same "one case per member" contract for the agent tools that
do not come from the catalogue (`open_document`, `save_document_as`, `export_document`, `render_page` with edge arguments);
commands that refuse without an error notice (today `run_command` sees them only if they publish an error).

## Audit, twenty-fifth round (2026-10-25)

Goal "minor defects only". `--no-incremental` build without warnings, full suite green in one pass, corpus
rerun (see at the end). **This time the app came to the foreground**: every click and key went through a check
that the foreground process was our instance and that the coordinates fell within its window (throwaway data
folder `live25`, captures with `windowshot --pid`, clipboard cleared at the end). The check has become a project
tool, `tools/uiprobe/topmost <pid> <x> <y>`: the foreground app must be our pid and, in z order, the
first window at the click point must be ours (the transparent layers of the Dock and the Window Server, which always cover
the whole screen, are excluded: without excluding them the check refused every point). Documented in the README, with the
route for when macOS does not grant the foreground (first click on the title bar, only with `--ignore-front` and our
window on top at that point).

### 1. Live, with clicks and keys
- **"Proteggi foglio" from the interface** (Review › Protection): modal with backdrop, "Proteggi" (Protect), then a digit typed in
  A2 → "La cella è protetta" (The cell is protected) with "Togli la protezione…" (Unprotect…); unprotecting asks for the password in a modal
  (`proteggi.png`, `protetto-ui.png`, `sblocca2.png`). **Minor, fixed**: the ribbon button did not show that the
  sheet was protected; now it is lit (`CheckedWhen`, `protetto-acceso.png`).
- **Paste special of HTML**: table with caption, headers, `align=right` and `colspan` put on the clipboard with
  `NSPasteboard`, ⌘⇧V → "Incolla speciale" (Paste special) modal (`incolla-speciale.png`) → "Incolla" (Paste): caption in the first row,
  headers in bold, total right-aligned, "Fine" merged and centred (`incollato.png`).
- **Signatures window** on the ODT with macros signed by the reference suite (`valid_ooo3_2_doc_macro.odt`, copy in the
  scratchpad): signature "Valid EE Certificate Test1", "certificato non attendibile" (untrusted certificate), date, authority and expiry
  (`firme-finestra.png`). **Minor, fixed**: the signature field in the status bar could not be clicked (in
  the reference suite it opens the signatures); now `StatusSegment.CommandId` is a status bar link, and the signature one
  opens "Firme digitali" (`firme-dalla-barra.png`). The "Certificato" (Certificate) menu (keychain) was not opened.
- **Sheet tab colour**: **minor, fixed** — the pop-up palette above the tab did not take
  focus, so Esc did not close it and the keyboard did not reach it; now focus goes to the first control ("Nessun colore" (No colour),
  with the style's focus ring, `tab-colore2.png`) and Esc closes it (`tab-colore-esc.png`). Applies to every
  `TabOverlays.ShowAsync`.
- **Minor, fixed** — icons had their stroke scaled twice (`IconView`: thickness × scale inside an
  already scaled transform): at 16 px lines were 0.7 px and icon dots (the ÷ of "Incolla speciale", Folio's
  grid) vanished, the ÷ looked like a −. Now the stroke is 1.6 grid units, as the name says.
- Folio's "Vai alla pagina" (Go to page) (⌘G) moves focus to the "Pagina 1 di 1" (Page 1 of 1) field of the status bar: seen on screen
  (`vai-pagina.png`).

### 2. Every command in the registry, executed
`CommandSweepTests` (twelve slices: three modules × four, to stay below the five-minute cap per test) composes
the app without a real interface, with fake file dialogs, printers, mail, scanner, keychain and exit, and for **every
enabled command** of the module and of the shell opens a new document in a typical context (Ledger: 10, 20, `=A1+A2` and a
text, selection A1:A4; Folio: one selected paragraph; Deck: the initial slide), runs it, closes modals,
side pane and inline inserts (Esc) and looks at what changed: history, documents, modals, pane, clipboard,
file dialog, "checked" state, focus, selection, window pixels. It fails if a command throws an exception,
hangs, or **runs without effect and without a reason**; the few legitimate non-actions (zoom already at 100 %, Latin text
without kana, selection already sorted…) are listed with their reason in `AlreadyInThatState`. Last pass: Ledger 388
commands (360 run, 28 justified refusals), Folio 337 (320 + 17), Deck 238 (224 + 14), plus the shell ones in each
module.
- **Medium, fixed** — **command refusals were not a result**: `CommandExecutor.ExecuteAsync` returned
  nothing, the agent saw only red notices (yellow "Niente da…" (Nothing to…) notices passed as "Ran"), an exception
  became "refused" and refused commands became the "last command to repeat" and entered the recorded macro.
  Now `CommandOutcome` (`Ran`, `NotApplicable`, `Refused`, `Cancelled`, `Failed`, reason and messages) collects from the
  notification history what the command publishes; `run_command` reports all of it. Test
  `I_comandi_si_elencano_e_ogni_rifiuto_arriva_all_agente`.
- **Medium, fixed** — "Seleziona colonna" and "Seleziona riga" (Select column / Select row) (⌃⇧Space, ⌃Space) selected only up to the last
  used cell, while a click on the header and the reference suite take the whole column or row: a format applied
  afterwards stopped halfway down the column. Now up to `MaxRows`/`MaxColumns`.
- **Medium, fixed** — Deck inserted images and audio/video with Avalonia's picker directly (outside
  `IFileDialogService`, so without a translated title and not testable), `deck.insert.media` was launched without awaiting it
  (exceptions lost, the agent said "Ran" before the choice) and an unreadable image did nothing **in all three
  modules**. Now `IDeckFileInsertion` uses the shared components `IRasterImageFiles` and `IPackagedFilePrompt` (the same
  as Ledger and Folio), media placement is a single one (also for the media player), and `PickAsync` says
  "Immagine illeggibile: nome" (Unreadable image: name); the photo album lists the discarded photos.
- **Minor, fixed** — silent non-actions turned into refusals with a reason or commands disabled when they do not apply:
  "Sblocca riquadri"/"Rimuovi divisione" (Unfreeze panes / Remove split) enabled without panes (now disabled, `PanesAreSplit` in the sheet context);
  "Fissa/Dividi alla selezione" (Freeze/Split at selection) on A1; "Cancella formattazione condizionale" (Clear conditional formatting) without rules; "Struttura automatica" (Auto outline) without
  summary formulas; "Seleziona formula matrice" (Select array formula) outside an array; "Vai alla pagina" without pages; "Entra nel
  gruppo" (Enter group), "Ancoraggio" (Anchor), "Esporta immagine" (Export image) enabled without an object (now disabled); "Linee guida durante lo spostamento" (Guides while moving) without
  a checked state. New texts in the five languages.

### 1. The command sweep in seven new contexts
`CommandSweepTests` now takes the context from a strategy (`ISweepScenario`): typical (as before), object selected
(Ledger, Folio, Deck), text being edited in a shape (Ledger, Deck; the scenario checks that editing is really
open), cell being edited, read-only document (three modules), protected sheet, protected section in Folio,
running slide show. In the "state" contexts (object, shape, cell, slide show) the module commands run are those
the context **enables** compared with the typical one; in the "refusal" ones (read-only, protected sheet, protected
section) all enabled module commands. Changes of selected object and of text editing are also counted.
With the new contexts the sweep takes about half an hour: it moved into its own project, `PulseOffice.Desktop.Sweep.Tests`, which
runs in parallel with the others; the cap of the test process watchdog is raised per project with the property
`TestProcessLifetimeMinutes` (here 50, elsewhere it stays 20). `HeadlessDesktopSession` left `CompositionTests` for a file
of its own, shared by link.

Found and fixed:
- **Serious** — **sheet protection did not protect** against commands: on a protected sheet rows and columns
  were inserted and deleted, shapes, charts, text boxes and form controls inserted, cells merged, date, time, fields
  and special characters written into locked cells, a page break inserted, the autofilter
  turned on. Now `ICommandEffectGuard` (in `PulseOffice.UI.Commands`, run by `CommandExecutor` around every
  command) has a strategy for Ledger, `LedgerProtectionGuard`: it snapshots the protected sheet before the command
  (`ISheetSnapshots`) and, if afterwards objects, merges, breaks or locked cells have changed, undoes back to the starting
  point of the history and says why ("non consente di modificare gli oggetti" (does not allow modifying objects), "di cambiare righe e colonne" (changing rows and columns), "La cella
  è protetta"). Inserting and deleting rows and columns is already refused at the source according to the protection permissions
  (`AllowInsertRows`…), even when it would move nothing; the autofilter according to `AllowFilter` (new text in the
  five languages).
- **Serious** — **a protected Folio section could be changed**: list styles, horizontal line and the like wrote
  into the protected content through the services. Same structure: `FolioProtectedContentGuard` compares the paragraphs
  of the protected sections before and after the command, undoes and says "Questa parte del documento è protetta" (This part of the document is protected) (the text
  existed and was unused).
- **Medium** — in a protected section typing, deleting, formatting, pasting and inserting an index were refused
  **silently**. `FolioEditor.RefusesEdit()` replaces `Locked()` at the points that modify and raises `Refused`;
  `IFolioEditRefusals` shows it in the status bar.
- **Medium** — in Deck, with a shape's text being edited, the Character, Paragraph and Bullets and
  numbering dialogs (and font, size and line spacing without an argument, which open them) did nothing: they read only the
  text of text boxes. Now they read `DeckTarget.ReadText()`/`ReadRange()`, which applies to text boxes and shapes.
- **Minor**: upper/lower case on a protected sheet refused without saying so (now "La cella è protetta"); "Taglia" (Cut) on
  protected cells still put the copy on the clipboard (now refuses before capturing); with an **empty** shape
  selected in Deck bold, colours, alignments and the like were enabled and did nothing (now disabled until the
  shape has text); "Stili rapidi" (Quick styles) without a choice did nothing (now opens the object's style, through
  `IDeckObjectEditing.EditStyleAsync`); closing a presentation **while it is being shown** left the
  show open (now it closes with the document); "Allinea al centro/in basso" (Align centre/bottom) of a Folio frame taller than the anchor
  line had no effect (the negative offset was clipped to zero); "Oggetto successivo" (Next object) with a single object
  already selected was enabled without effect (now disabled); "Espandi voce del glossario" (Expand AutoText entry) without a word before the caret
  stayed silent (new text in the five languages).
- Legitimate non-actions added with their reason to `AlreadyInThatState`: the new frame is already anchored to the character, already
  at the top, already with parallel wrap; a short word has no hyphenation points.

Last pass of the new contexts: 1949 executions (1657 with effect, 292 justified refusals). Regression tests:
`ContextRefusalTests` (protected sheet: case, cut, rows, columns, shapes, date, filter; protected section: typing
and lists; AutoText; frame centring and "Oggetto successivo"; Paragraph dialog on a shape's text and empty
shape with formatting disabled; slide show closed with the document).

## Architecture review: the Ledger grid (2026-10-26)
`SheetGridView` (2684 lines with drawing, input, object selection, scrolling, gestures and editing) is now a shell of
462 lines composing collaborators in `PulseOffice.Sheets.UI.GridParts`, built by `SheetGridPartsFactory`:
`GridViewport` (geometry, scrolling and frozen panes, hit test, object coordinates), the layer painters
(`GridHeaderPainter`, `GridCellPainter` with `CellDecorationPainter` and `CellValuePainter`, `GridOverlayPainter`,
`GridObjectPainter`), input (`GridPointerInput`, `GridKeyboardInput`, `FreeformDrawing`), `GridObjectSelection` and the
events in `GridNotifications`. Gestures are a single State (`GridGesture` with `GestureStage`): selection, resizing
of rows and columns, fill, dragging and rotating objects, adjustment handles, path points,
control scroll bar; they are created by `GridGestureFactory`. The public API of `SheetGridView` does not change.
## Architecture review: LedgerView and LedgerCommands (2026-10-26)
`LedgerView` (1610 lines) and `LedgerCommands` (1274) far exceeded the size of a class with one responsibility.
Restructured without `partial` and without changing behaviour:
- `LedgerCommands` is now a 24-line facade that concatenates, in the same order as before, six command sets
  registered via DI on the model of the other `Ledger*Commands`: `LedgerCellFormatCommands` (font, alignment,
  number formats, fill), `LedgerPaneCommands` (freeze and split panes, zoom), `LedgerEditDataCommands`
  (clipboard, sort, filter, Find and replace), `LedgerConditionalRuleCommands` (quick conditional
  formatting), `LedgerChartCommands` (charts, gallery and editing) and `LedgerShapeCommands` (shapes, images, connectors,
  alignment, order, groups). `EditSelectedChart` stays on `LedgerCommands` and delegates to charts.
- `LedgerView` (560 lines) remains the composition root of the control and composes the collaborators in
  `Sheets.UI/LedgerViewParts`: `LedgerCellWriter` (validated writing with history, protection, autocorrect),
  `LedgerCellEditing` (in-cell editor, formula bar, name box, choice lists),
  `LedgerObjectEditing` (objects, freeform drawing, form controls), `LedgerCellOperations` (clear, resize,
  fill, styles required by formulas), `LedgerShapeTextSession` (text in shapes), `LedgerStatusSegments`
  (summary and zoom in the status bar), `LedgerViewLayout`. The collaborators notify the view with the
  `SelectionStale` event instead of calling it back; the view's public `init` properties remain and forward to the collaborators.
Checks: build without warnings, `Architecture.Tests`, `Sheets.UI.Tests` and `Desktop.Tests` filtered on Ledger green.
## Deck architecture review: DeckView and DeckActions decomposed (2026-10-26)
`DeckView` (2254 lines) and `DeckActions` (1085) did too many things. Restructured into collaborators with one
responsibility each, without `partial` and without changing behaviour or public API.

- **`DeckActions`** remains the facade used by commands, macros and tests (same constructor signature, same methods) and
  delegates by area: `DeckSlideActions` (slides, sections, backgrounds), `DeckElementActions` (objects, groups, tables,
  images, interactions), `DeckTextActions` (texts, notes, comments), `DeckDesignActions` (theme, masters, graphic styles),
  `DeckShowActions` (transitions, animations, custom shows, settings). History, read-only,
  fitting text to the frame and focus requests live in `DeckActionRecorder`, shared by the five.
- **`DeckView`** remains the control and the composition root of its parts: shared state in `DeckViewState`
  (current slide, selection, mode, target), callbacks to the view behind `IDeckViewHost` (internal
  interface, implemented explicitly so as not to widen the public API). Parts: `DeckFilmstrip` (thumbnail
  pane and sections), `DeckInspector` (transitions, animations, interactions), `DeckModeViews` and `DeckMasterViews`
  (sorter, outline, notes, masters), `DeckTextEditing` and `DeckShapeTextEditing` (inline editing),
  `DeckTextCorrection`, `DeckProofing`, `DeckStageNavigation` (zoom and pan), `DeckCanvasMenus`,
  `DeckCanvasEditing` (transforms and connectors), `DeckStageKeys`, `DeckColorBar`, `DeckAnimationPlayer`,
  `DeckObjectInsertion`, `ControlAncestry`. No class exceeds 600 lines.
- Check: build without warnings, Presentations.UI, Architecture and Desktop (Deck filter) tests green.

## CPython macros: finding Python after the Homebrew update (2026-11-01)

The full run after the shared selection frame made the three "with an installed Python" tests of
`CPythonScriptEngineTests` fail (PY0005). Cause, verified with a probe in the scratchpad: Homebrew, updated on 2026-10-31,
no longer puts `python3` in `opt/python@3.x/bin` (only `python3.13`, `python3.14`), so `PythonDiscovery` found only
the Python 3.9 of Xcode and the Command Line Tools; and it accepted it, because the minimum was 3.9 while pythonnet 3.1 can start
only from 3.10 ("Python ABI v3.9.6 is not supported"). Medium defect: CPython did not start on a Mac with a recent Homebrew.

Fix: `PythonExecutableNames` (injected into `PathSource` and `MacInstallSource`) looks for `python3`, `python3.14`…`python3.10`
and `python`; `PythonVersionRange.MinimumVersion` is 3.10. Now the automatic choice finds Homebrew 3.14.10 and 3.13.18, picks
3.14 and startup succeeds. New tests: `PythonVersionRangeTests` (3.9 and 3.15 out, 3.10–3.14 in; the automatic choice never
proposes an unsupported version). `--no-incremental` build without warnings, full suite green (40 projects).

## Protection outside the history (2026-11-03)

User's decision of 2026-11-02: as in the reference suite's spreadsheet, protecting or unprotecting (and turning change
recording on or off) **is not a history step**. ⌘Z neither removes nor restores a protection, and undoing or
redoing any other step does not touch it. The document still becomes modified, because the protection must be saved.

Shared mechanism, one for the three modules:
- `UndoStack.ApplyOutsideHistory(Action)` applies the change without pushing anything, raises `ChangedOutsideHistory` and
  `Changed`; `OpenDocument` listens to `ChangedOutsideHistory` and calls `MarkModified()`. Inside a transaction (macro,
  agent) the change does not enter the composite step.
- `CommandDefinition.OutsideHistory` declares the command; `ShellAgentCommands` carries it into `AgentCommandInfo` and
  `AgentCommandPolicy.IsIrreversible` treats it as irreversible, so the agent asks for confirmation in a modal.
- In Ledger the helper `LedgerCommandSet.OutsideHistory`; in Folio `editor.History.ApplyOutsideHistory`.

Per command:
- `ledger.worksheet.protect`: previously a `DelegateAction` "Protezione del foglio" (Sheet protection) (the key `history.sheet.protect` removed
  from the five languages); now outside the history.
- `ledger.file.protectStructure`, `ledger.review.protectChanges`: previously in the history, now outside.
- `ledger.changes.record`: previously a history step; now outside. The test that checked that redo did not
  bypass change protection becomes moot and verifies that there is nothing to undo.
- **Ledger snapshots** (serious): `ChangeLogMemento`, taken by `WorkbookCheckpoints.Capture` before sorting, filtering,
  importing etc., contained `IsRecording`, `IsProtected` and `ProtectionHash`: undoing a step done before
  protecting the changes unprotected them. The memento now keeps only the recorded changes and `ShowChanges`.
  `SheetSnapshot` contained no protection; sheets come back as the same instances, with their protection.
- `folio.protect.document`, `folio.changes.protect`, `folio.changes.record`: were already outside the history, but **did not
  make the document modified** (closing without saving silently lost the protection). Now they go through
  `ApplyOutsideHistory`. Folio's mementos are fine-grained (paragraphs, containers, tables, lists) and do not touch
  `Protection`, `Marks` or the properties of the change log.
- `folio.tools.protectFields` / `protectBookmarks`: they are document settings (like the protect-fields and
  protect-bookmarks settings of the reference suite's word processor, which it does not undo); previously a history step, now outside.
- `folio.table.protect` / `unprotect` and section protection stay **in the history**: in the reference suite's word processor they are attributes
  of the cell and of the section, which it undoes; they are content, not document protection.
- Deck has no protections of its own; the file password (`ShellPasswordCommands`) was already outside the history.
- Macros: `ScriptApiCatalog` exposes no protections, nothing to change.
- Effect guards: they undo back to the history's starting point, where the protection is no longer present, so they
  cannot bring it back.

Tests (they fail first, verified by reapplying the fixes in reverse with `git apply -R`):
`LedgerProtectionOutsideHistoryTests` (9 cases: protect and ⌘Z, edit-protect-undo-redo for sheet, structure,
changes; recording; earlier snapshot), `FolioProtectionOutsideHistoryTests` (10 cases), `OpenDocumentTests`
(change outside the history marks modified), the agent's `SecurityTests` (confirmation). Green: Sheets.UI, Documents.UI,
Sheets.Engine, Shell, Agent, Desktop, Architecture, Localization.

To try live: in Ledger protect the sheet, ⌘Z (it stays protected, the Edit menu does not show "Annulla
protezione" (Undo protection)), modified dot on the tab; type in a cell, protect the changes, sort, ⌘Z twice
(stays protected); in Folio protect the document and close (asks to save); from the agent `run_command
ledger.worksheet.protect` asks for confirmation.

## File write permission for a macro, with confirmation (2026-11-03)

User's decision of 2026-11-02. Macros stay in the sandbox; now a single macro can receive from the user the
permission to write text files, and only that.

- **What receives the permission: the macro, by code fingerprint.** `Sha256MacroFingerprints` computes the SHA-256 of
  language + source (line endings normalized). Module and document were rejected: a received document could
  add a new macro to an already "trusted" document, or change the code of an approved macro. With the fingerprint,
  if the code changes by even one character the permission lapses; the same code in another language does not inherit it.
  Declared limit: another document containing exactly the same code inherits it — it is the same code
  the user read and approved.
- **The permission does not travel in the document.** `FileMacroWriteGrants` keeps it in `macro-file-permissions.json` in the
  local configuration folder (`IUserDataPaths`), a list of fingerprints; a damaged, too large or unreadable file
  grants nothing. `DocumentMacro` has no permission field at all (test). It is granted **only** from the macro editor
  (button "Scrittura file: no / concessa" (File writing: no / granted) in the bar, `MacroWriteAccessButton`), after an integrated modal with backdrop
  (`MacroWriteConfirmation`, `ChoicePromptView`, default choice "Annulla" (Cancel)) that explains the risk and the folder, in the
  five languages. The same button revokes. The editor is shared, so it applies in Folio, Deck and Ledger.
- **A distinct, confined capability.** New `ScriptCapability.MacroFolderWrite` (and `ScriptPermissions.MacroFolderWrite`):
  `MacroPermissionPolicy` adds it to granted macros; it does not give `FileSystemWrite`, so `page.ExportPdf` (which writes
  wherever it wants) stays refused to a granted macro and available only to the agent at the "files" level. The permission
  applies in the editor, to Folio's buttons (`FolioFormEvents`) and to the events of Ledger's controls (`FormEventRunner`).
- **API**: shared root `files` (`ScriptFilesFacade`, in `ShellScriptApi`, hence in the completion of the three modules and
  in JS/Jint and IronPython; CPython receives the same globals): `Folder`, `WriteText(name, text)`,
  `AppendText(name, text)`, `Exists(name)`. Every call performs `Demand(MacroFolderWrite)`.
- **Where it writes**: only in `Documenti/PulseOffice/Macros` (Documents/PulseOffice/Macros) (`MacroFileFolder`). Rejected "wherever the user chooses" at each
  call (a modal per file makes a macro that writes in a loop unusable) and the whole documents folder
  (too exposed). Refused: absolute paths outside the folder, `..`, hidden or invalid names, passing through
  symbolic links under the folder, extensions other than txt, csv, tsv, json, xml, md, html, htm, log (no
  executables, scripts, libraries); cap of 16 M characters per write.
- **Agent**: the MCP server reaches neither `IMacroWriteGrants` nor `IMacroPermissionPolicy` (test by reflection
  on the assembly), and its scripts receive only the permissions of the chosen level: at the "edit" level `files.WriteText`
  is refused (test). Declared limit: at the "files" level the agent already saves wherever it wants with confirmation, so it could in
  theory also overwrite the permissions file; that remains covered by the overwrite confirmation.
- The permission is evaluated when the macro starts: revoking it does not stop an execution already in progress.

Tests: `MacroWritePermissionTests` (Scripting: without permission refused in JS and Python; with permission it writes; changed
code lapses; other language does not; revocation; reloading from settings; damaged file; the document does not carry the
permission; traversal, absolute paths, extensions, hidden names, links), `MacroWritePermissionAgentTests` (Agent),
`ScriptApiCatalogTests` updated. To try live: button in the editor of the three modules, modal with backdrop, writing
in `Documenti/PulseOffice/Macros`, editing the code turning the button back to "no".

## Digital signatures without a trusted timestamp (2026-11-03)

User's decision of 2026-11-02. The date inside a signature (`dc:date`, `xades:SigningTime`, the PDF's `signingTime`)
is declared by the signer and proves nothing. `CertificateJudge` now:

- with a **trusted RFC 3161 timestamp** (`TrustedTimestampVerifier`: `Rfc3161TimestampToken`, timestamp signature
  over the stamped data, authority chain valid at the timestamp's date, timestamp not in the future) judges the certificate at the
  timestamp's date; timestamp after expiry → certificate expired;
- **without** a trusted timestamp judges as of **today**: certificate valid today → as before; expired today →
  `SignatureStatus.UnverifiableInTime` ("valid but not verifiable in time": signature intact, chain trusted at
  expiry, but it cannot be established that the certificate was valid when signing); not yet valid → expired. A timestamp
  over other data or from an untrusted authority counts as absent.
- Timestamp read from XAdES (`SignatureTimeStamp/EncapsulatedTimeStamp` over the canonicalized `SignatureValue`:
  `XadesTimestampLocator`, for ODF and OOXML) and from the PDF (unsigned attribute `id-aa-timeStampToken` over the signature
  value). Macro signatures have no timestamp: they are judged as of today.
- Certificate trust behind `ICertificateTrust` (Template Method `ChainCertificateTrust`: `SystemCertificateTrust`
  in production, `CustomRootCertificateTrust` in tests with generated certificates, without touching the keychain); clock
  from `TimeProvider`.
- Interface: the outcome has its own text (`signature.status.unverifiableInTime`) in the five languages and the look of a
  warning (yellow) in the signatures pane of the three modules and in the PDF one; the status bar indicator says
  "Firmato, non verificabile nel tempo" (Signed, not verifiable in time). For the macro gate it is not "valid": it asks for confirmation.

Tests: `TimestampTests` (valid today; expired without timestamp; declared date within validity but expired today → new
outcome in a signed ODF; trusted timestamp within validity → valid; timestamp after expiry → expired; timestamp over other
data; untrusted authority), `CertificateJudgeTests` and `ForgedSignatureTests` updated to the new rule. Not covered
by tests: the timestamp in the PDF (reading the attribute); to be tried with a real timestamped PDF. To see live: a document
signed with an expired certificate shows the yellow warning.

## Deep audit, second round (2026-11-03)

Six areas, each in its own branch, merged into `deep-audit-round-2`; per-area notes in `docs/deep-audit/*-round2.md`.
Before the round, a live test found that undo and redo bypassed sheet and document protection (an edit made before
protecting could be undone on a locked cell); fixed by running the protection guards on undo and redo too
(`IHistoryReversals`), with tests for Ledger and Folio.

- **Shell and shared UI**: MCP agent transactions and macro runs now pass the command effect guards (`ICommandEffectChecks`,
  `IGuardedMacroRuns`); 31 headless tests that could never fail (missing `.Unwrap()`) fixed, which exposed a gallery
  keyboard defect; Folio character dialog «Default» language now clears the language; a key consumed by a shortcut no
  longer types into the grid; Ledger select row is Shift+Space (⌘Space is reserved by macOS); macro editor file-write
  button integrated in the toolbar.
- **Sheet model and engine**: SUBTOTAL/AGGREGATE were made volatile by the first round (100 unrelated edits with 2,000
  subtotals: 144 s, now milliseconds) and now recalculate on row visibility changes; `SheetLayout` is run-length
  (`RunLengthMap`, `RunLengthSet`); multiple operations no longer need a 512 MB thread; tracked changes follow sheet and
  row/column structure; whole-row formatting is one undo step.
- **Folio**: limits against documents built to explode (doubling set-variable fields, huge note start values, repeated
  spaces, column count, list levels beyond ten); linear run merging and indexed anchored objects, notes and comments.
- **Deck**: recovery snapshot errors are reported; the slide panel rebuilds only changed thumbnails
  (`SlideFrameCache`); the theme gallery golden image regenerated after the intentional slide-scaled strokes (99b2c201).
- **Platform**: video export streams frames (`IVideoFrameSource`) with cancellation and a translated error reason;
  macro file writing no longer follows a symlink swapped in after the check; permission save failures no longer crash
  the editor; temporary-file cleanup skips live sessions; agent operation log rotates.
- **Ledger UI**: conditional formatting caches range data per rule (`ConditionalRangeSnapshots`); copying whole columns
  or the whole sheet is limited to the used area.
- **Formats**: quadratic paths removed (XLSX number formats 64.8 s → 0.9 s, merges, ODP shape order, hyperlinks);
  ODS repeats were silently capped at 4,096 copies, now a 4-million-cell budget with warning `ODF270`; ODS layout repeats
  are read as intervals.

Verification: full suite green (40 projects, command sweep included); corpus LOSS 0, DECL 529, 9,948 copies, unchanged;
live: undo after protection refused in Ledger, Shift+Space selects the row. Still open: style bands for whole rows ×
formatted columns (proposal in `docs/deep-audit/ledger-ui-round2.md`), partial re-reads listed in the round notes, video
export on Windows and Linux never run, live check of mp4 export on macOS.

## Folio: wider auto-redaction and Word-style "forms only" protection (2026-11-05)

Two user decisions of 2026-11-04, closing R5-L1 of [deep-audit/folio-ui-round5.md](deep-audit/folio-ui-round5.md).

**Auto-redaction** (`folio.tools.autoRedact`) now also runs `IMetadataRedaction` (`PulseOffice.Documents.Editing`) in
the same history transaction as the text pass, so one ⌘Z restores everything: title, subject, comments (description),
author, last author and keywords are cleared, text custom properties are emptied (number, date and boolean ones are
kept), visible bookmarks (not starting with `_`) are renamed `Bookmark1`, `Bookmark2`… while bookmark and reference
fields and `#name` hyperlinks follow the new name, and every comment and tracked change gets the neutral author
(`redact.folio.author`, five languages; comment initials are dropped). The status bar reports paragraphs, properties,
bookmarks and distinct authors (`redact.folio.auto.done`). Undo of the properties goes through a new
`PropertiesMemento` (`EditRecorder.Touch(DocumentProperties)`); comments and changes are replaced by new objects so
the list memento restores the old ones. Verified by writing ODT and DOCX and scanning every package entry (content,
styles, meta.xml, docProps, comments, people): the redacted name appears nowhere. On a real save the shell still stamps
the current user as last author, which is expected. Not covered: the text kept inside tracked deletions and the
authors of saved versions.

**Forms-only protection** (`DocumentRestriction.Forms`, `ProtectForm` in ODT, `w:documentProtection w:edit="forms"` in
DOCX): content controls are filled as in Word, everything else stays locked. `IFormFilling`
(`PulseOffice.Documents.Protection`) decides: typing is allowed only when the caret or the selection lies inside one
control that accepts typing (rich and plain text, combo box, date; not content-locked), and choosing (check box,
drop-down, date, picture) when the control is not content-locked; in both cases the control's paragraphs must pass
the guard without the document restriction (`IEditGuard.CheckContent`), so protected sections and cells still win.
`FolioEditor` uses it in typing, Backspace, Delete and line breaks of multi-line plain text; `Shielded` refuses every
range not inside a fillable control (so deleting across a control edge, or merging paragraphs, is refused), typing
beside a control is refused, and paragraphs are not split. `FolioContentControls` lets click and choose through, while
removing a control and changing its properties are now refused under any protection (they only checked read-only
before). `FolioProtectedContentGuard` adds a `FormRegion`: a `FormOutline` of every story with the interiors of
fillable controls collapsed and the value fields of the controls (shown placeholder, checked, date) neutralised; a
command that changes anything else is undone. Formatting, paste, cut, inserting objects or controls stay refused.
Round trip of the restriction with its controls verified in ODT and DOCX.

Tests: `FolioAutoRedactionTests` (2), `FolioFormProtectionTests` (5); they failed before the change except the two
that only confirm what was already right (text outside controls was already locked, and the restriction already
crossed both formats). Documents.UI.Tests 279/279, Documents.Tests 272/272, Architecture.Tests and Localization.Tests
green.

## Declared losses block B9: paragraph-mark and row revisions (2026-11-05)

Deleted paragraph marks are read as joins (one point `Deletion` per junction holding both sides with their paragraph
properties) and written back as `w:pPr/w:rPr/w:del` by splitting the paragraph (`DocxParagraphMarkJoins`,
`DocxParagraphMarkSplits`). Tracked table rows are model data (`TableRow.ChangeId`), cross DOCX (`w:trPr/w:ins|w:del`)
and ODT (`pt:change-id` on `table:table-row`), and are accepted or rejected through `ITrackedRows`. DOCX122 removed;

Shape text has a list model (`ShapeObject.Lists`, one `ShapeListItem` per paragraph with level, numbering and the shared

### Round 53: Ledger locale, whole-column recalculation, Excel regular expressions (2026-11-06)

The spreadsheet locale now follows the interface language (`InterfaceSpreadsheetLocale`, `LocaleNumberFormatter`);
conditional-format operands and pasted text use it. Whole-column SUM/COUNT/COUNTA/SUMIFS/COUNTIFS keep per-block partial
results (`WholeColumnAggregates`), so filling rows one at a time is no longer quadratic; `CalculationEngine.Batch` recalculates
once for value writes and fill. REGEXTEST, REGEXEXTRACT and REGEXREPLACE added with the REGEX guard shared (`GuardedRegex`).
Details in [deep-audit/round-53-ledger-locale-recalc.md](deep-audit/round-53-ledger-locale-recalc.md).

### Deep audit round 55: locale leftovers (2026-11-06)

Form controls are drawn in the document or sheet culture (`IFormControlRenderer` takes a culture; Folio and Deck pass the
language through `ShapeSurroundings`, formerly `ShapeBackdrop`); Ledger form controls show localized TRUE/FALSE; shape list
text fields receive the workbook language; every new or imported Folio, Deck and Ledger document gets a default language
(the interface language, `IInterfaceCulture`) when the file declares none, written back in ODF and OOXML; the alphabetical
index sorts by the document language. Details in
[deep-audit/round-55-locale-leftovers.md](deep-audit/round-55-locale-leftovers.md).

### Round 57: dialog answers and agent edits while a modal is open (2026-11-06)

Cross-cutting fix for the round 56 pattern. The agent no longer mutates anything while a modal is open
(`IAgentOperationGate.EditAsync`: edits, macros, commands, open, create, activate, save). `DialogHost` admits a dialog's
answer only if the document is still open, not newly read-only and every module `IDocumentStateWitness` (Ledger
structure/sheet protection and sheet list, Folio document/section/field/tracked-change/cell protection, Deck current
slide and selection) still matches what it saw when the dialog opened; otherwise the answer becomes a cancel with a
status warning. Details in [deep-audit/round-57-after-dialog.md](deep-audit/round-57-after-dialog.md).

### Deep audit round 84: agent server, private files, localized tool titles (2026-11-06)
The operation log keeps only the shape of the arguments, never document text; every script catalog member has a short
title in five languages used for «Agente: …» undo labels, confirmations and the operations list; the access code and
the operation log go through `IPrivateFiles` (Unix 0600/0700, Windows owner-only ACL); `"id": null` requests are
refused; agent page pictures are bounded; the server controller subscribes once and exposes `Settled`. Details in
[deep-audit/round-84-agent-server.md](deep-audit/round-84-agent-server.md).

Folio gains paragraph direction and right-to-left run embeddings in the model, an own Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm

hit-testing and Left/Right caret motion, and the «Left-to-right text» / «Right-to-left text» commands in Folio, Deck and
Ledger (five languages). ODT/DOCX and ODP/PPTX carry the direction both ways. A quadratic scan found while testing (the

drops the drop cap. Details in [deep-audit/round-94-bidi.md](deep-audit/round-94-bidi.md).

### Deep audit round 100: range move and sheet copy, second pass (2026-11-07)

The «Remaining» of round 97. A copied sheet duplicates its tables with unique names (`Table1_2`), filters, totals and
advanced criteria, and its formulas use the new names; filters and tables wholly inside a moved range move with it (also
to another sheet), only cut ones refuse; conditional formats and validations partly inside are split with re-anchored
formulas; pending tracked changes follow moved cells (`ChangeLog.Relocate`); form controls carried to another sheet
qualify their links with the source sheet. Each is one undo step. Details in

### Deep audit round 112: object anchoring, split objects in print, PDF export (2026-11-07)

Ledger objects carry an anchoring mode (`ObjectAnchoring`: move and size with cells, move only, fixed). Row and column
resizing, hiding and showing reflow them through `SheetLayout.GeometryChanging/Changed` and `SheetObjectFollower`;
insertion and deletion go through the structure part with the geometry captured before the change. XLSX writes and reads
`twoCellAnchor@editAs` (also `oneCellAnchor`, `absoluteAnchor`, form-control `moveWithCells/sizeWithCells`); ODS writes
`table:end-cell-address` only for move-and-size and puts fixed objects in `table:shapes`. `IPageCanvas.Clip` lets
`ClippedPageCanvas` cut images and paths instead of dropping them, so an object across a page edge prints in parts. The
page setup dialog shows a custom paper as «Custom», and the macro print API has the first page number and the header
variants. Details in [deep-audit/round-112-anchoring-pdf.md](deep-audit/round-112-anchoring-pdf.md).

## Linux AppImage instead of Flatpak (2026-11-08)

The Flatpak bundle attached to releases is replaced by AppImages for x86_64 and aarch64 (`pulse-cmd.py linux`, built in a
`debian:bookworm-slim` container with `appimagetool`; file modes normalised to 0755/0644). Reasons: the Flatpak sandbox
hides `lp`, `ffmpeg` and `secret-tool`, and a bundle installed from a file never updates. The automatic updater now
covers Linux: `AppImageUpdateInstaller` stages the verified AppImage next to the running one (`APPIMAGE`), swaps it after
exit and reopens it. Verified: the aarch64 AppImage starts on Ubuntu 24.04 under Xvfb and opens its main window. The
system ICU library is required. Flathub was evaluated and dropped because of its generative AI policy.

## AppImage desktop integration (2026-11-10)

Decision 30. On the first start from an AppImage, PulseOffice offers to add itself to the applications menu (icon, file
types) and to move into `~/Applications`. The menu entry runs a small launcher script that finds the image even after a
move, or asks with `zenity`/`kdialog` to pick it, or shows a notice; when the app runs from a new place it offers to move
itself to `~/Applications`. Help › Show in Applications Menu adds or removes the integration. Tests: integration files,
move, removal and the launcher (registered image, moved image, nothing found) in `DesktopIntegrationTests`; the launcher
was also run under `dash` on Ubuntu 24.04. Not yet tried on a real Linux desktop session.

## Continuous packaging on GitHub Actions (2026-11-13)

`.github/workflows/packages.yml` builds all packages in CI: AppImages on native x86_64 and arm64 Ubuntu runners,
the NSIS installer on Windows, signed and notarized dmg images on macOS 15. A `v*` tag (checked against `<Version>`)
adds a job that signs `SHA256SUMS` and creates a draft release; manual runs only upload artifacts. Secrets live in the
`release` environment. `pulse-cmd.py` now reads credentials from the environment (`PULSE_MAC_IDENTITY`,
`PULSE_NOTARY_KEY`/`_KEY_ID`/`_ISSUER` for an App Store Connect API key, `PULSE_UPDATE_KEY`/`_PASSPHRASE`), has a
`sign` command, and lays out the dmg with `dmgbuild` instead of AppleScript driving Finder, which is unreliable on
headless runners; the window size, icon positions and Retina background are unchanged.

## `pulse-cmd.py bump --push` (2026-11-13)

`bump <part> --push` (or `--set X.Y.Z --push`) checks it runs on `main`, writes the version, commits every pending
change (`git add --all`) as "Version X.Y.Z", tags `vX.Y.Z` and pushes the commit and the tag without asking, so the
packaging workflow starts and leaves a draft release. Tried in a throwaway clone against a local bare remote.

## Linux window frame and launcher tests (2026-11-13)

First run on Fedora with GNOME (Wayland, app through XWayland). Defects found live:

- **GNOME title bar above ours** (medium): Avalonia 12's X11 backend honours `ExtendClientAreaToDecorationsHint` only
  with `X11PlatformOptions.EnableDrawnDecorations`, otherwise the window manager decorates the window. Enabled in
  `Program`; the option is experimental, so `AVALONIA_X11_CSD` is suppressed in the Desktop project only.
- **No frame and no shadow once Avalonia draws them** (medium): the Fluent decorations draw border and shadow in the
  underlay, in an 8 px margin below the client area, and an extended window must inset its content by
  `WindowDecorationMargin`. `ShellWindow` painted an opaque background over the whole surface. New
  `IWindowChrome.DrawsWindowShadow` (Linux only): the window becomes transparent, the canvas is painted by the root
  panel, inset by the margin minus our title bar. Seen live: frame, shadow, resizing, maximize without margin.
- **Launcher tests opened a real zenity dialog** (minor, tests only): `AppImageDesktopIntegrationTests` ran the launcher
  with `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin`, assuming no dialog tool there, true on macOS but not on Fedora. The launcher now gets a
  private folder with only `cat`, `ls`, `grep` and `chmod`.

## Desktop test suite on Linux (2026-11-13)

First full run of `PulseOffice.Desktop.Tests` on Fedora: six tests failed the same way on `main`, all of them assuming
macOS. Now 359 passed, 1 skipped.

- **Deck mp4 export failed on Fedora** (serious, product): the ffmpeg encoder always asked for `libx264`, which
  Fedora's ffmpeg does not ship. New `IFfmpegEncoderChoice` (`FfmpegEncoderChoice`, Platform) reads
  `ffmpeg -encoders` once and takes `libx264`, then `libopenh264`, then `mpeg4`, each with its own options; none of them
  gives `VIDEO006`. Four tests in `VideoEncodingRegressionTests`; the Deck export test encodes with the real ffmpeg.
- **Folio accessibility test pressed Meta** for the primary modifier: it now uses `ShortcutGesture.Primary` (Ctrl on
  Linux and Windows), also for Cmd+B, which passed by chance.
- **Ledger merged-cell text test** counted pixels darker than a fixed sum of 200; with the substitute font the text is
  lighter (darkest 229). Threshold 450 against the white cell; still red without the merge.
- **Gallery pixel tests** compared against images made with macOS fonts. The headless session registers the bundled
  Inter (`WithInterFont`), the gallery window uses it and the theme fonts (Arial, Courier New, Georgia, Trebuchet MS,
  Verdana) map to it, so the three golden images, regenerated and checked by eye, are the same on every system. To
  check on a Mac: in the old theme golden the accent line of Aurora and Laguna was teal, now it is lighter.
- Headless frames show black where nothing paints a background, because the test composition does not load the theme
  tokens; the real app paints them.
